LESSON: INTENSIVE SIGN READING COMPREHENSION (DIALOGUES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Intensive Sign Reading Comprehension (Dialogues
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Intensive Sign Reading Comprehension (Dialogues, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell the meaning of words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Intensive Sign Reading Comprehension (Dialogues together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: Making observation as learners make connections between the characters in the text and the people they know.

• Citizenship: Active community life skills as learners discuss as they sign about words related to the theme; jobs and occupation

• Critical thinking and problem solving: Open mindedness and creativity as learners sign read and role play a dialogue.

Values:
Responsibility: Self-drive as learner role play dialogues related to the theme.

Link to other Subjects:

The learner can apply the skill of reading for comprehension to all other areas of learning as they all require reading.
